findings: Matching syntax and unit results did not detect the configured zero value being lost at the affected consumer. The identical caller test detected and then passed after correcting the shared helper.

Playwright Test distinguished setup and test-body outcomes. Cleanup inside the acquisition scope released resources in both failure phases. The deliberately defective setup left its first allocation for the outer test harness to remove.
The 12 original public task identities and 36 attempts were preserved. Revised condition order balances positions globally and within each publisher difficulty stratum.
Published TestEval native metrics and independent pytest outcomes provide separate input-form and behavioral evidence. Neither source review nor native controls measure model improvement.
The old generated-artifact writer reused one temporary name. Independent controls verified that concurrent and rejected replacements leave consistent output after the repair.
